```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggprism)
  library(knitr)
})
for (f in list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)

cfg <- load_plate_config(params$config)
import_warnings <- character()
pm <- withCallingHandlers(read_plate_map(cfg$plate_map, cfg$conditions),
  warning = function(w) {
    import_warnings <<- c(import_warnings, conditionMessage(w))
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  })
cols <- plate_colors(pm$group, cfg$colors)
files <- list_timeforce_files(cfg$timeforce_dir, cfg$days, known = names(cfg$protocols))

# Configured protocols first (in config order), then anything else found
protocols <- c(intersect(names(cfg$protocols), files$protocol),
               sort(setdiff(files$protocol, names(cfg$protocols))))
png_dir  <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, "plate-traces")
anim_dir <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, "animations")

# Image links must be relative to this .qmd's folder: Quarto reads a leading
# "/" as project-relative, so absolute paths (output_dir outside R_reports, as
# the launcher uses) aren't found and aren't embedded.
img_link <- function(path) {
  as.character(fs::path_rel(normalizePath(path), start = normalizePath(getwd())))
}

describe_protocol <- function(p) {
  s <- protocol_settings(cfg, p)
  if (identical(s$type, "snapshot")) {
    sprintf("Snapshot of one contraction: %g s before to %g s after t = %g s (x = 0).",
            s$pre_s, s$post_s, s$time_s)
  } else if (is.null(s$end_s)) {
    "Whole recording (no `end_s` set for this protocol)."
  } else {
    sprintf("Whole protocol, 0–%g s. Anything recorded after %g s is not shown.", s$end_s, s$end_s)
  }
}
```

**Plate:** `r cfg$name` · **Config:** `r params$config` · **Rendered:** `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`

## Summary

```{r settings}
tibble(
  Setting = c("Time-force folder", "Plate map", "File format", "Days", "Output folder"),
  Value = c(cfg$timeforce_dir, cfg$plate_map,
            paste(unique(files$format), collapse = " + "),
            paste(sort(unique(files$day)), collapse = ", "),
            normalizePath(cfg$output_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
) |> kable()
```

### Plate map

```{r plate-map}
pm |>
  mutate(cell = if (is.null(cfg$conditions)) coalesce(label, "") else
           ifelse(is.na(label) | label == as.character(group), coalesce(label, ""),
                  paste0(label, " → ", group))) |>
  select(row, col, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = cell) |>
  rename(` ` = row) |>
  kable()
```

### Files found

```{r files}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(files) == 0) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\nNo time-force files with a `d<day>_` and `_<protocol>.csv` in their name were found in `",
      cfg$timeforce_dir, "`.\n:::\n", sep = "")
} else {
  files |>
    mutate(mark = "✓") |>
    select(day, protocol, mark) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = protocol, values_from = mark, values_fill = "–") |>
    select(day, any_of(protocols)) |>
    rename(Day = day) |>
    kable() |> print()
}
dups <- attr(files, "duplicates")
if (nrow(dups)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning}\n## More than one file for a day × protocol\nThe newest file is plotted. Not used:\n\n",
      paste0("- d", dups$day, " ", dups$protocol, ": `", basename(dups$file), "`", collapse = "\n"),
      "\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
misfiled <- attr(files, "misfiled")
if (NROW(misfiled)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning}\n## Files in a folder for a different protocol\nPlotted under the protocol in the file name:\n\n",
      paste0("- `", misfiled$folder, "/", basename(misfiled$file), "` → ", misfiled$protocol,
             collapse = "\n"),
      "\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
skipped <- attr(files, "skipped")
if (nrow(skipped)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-note}\n## Skipped (no day or protocol in the file name)\n\n",
      paste0("- `", basename(skipped$file), "`", collapse = "\n"), "\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
if (length(import_warnings)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning}\n## Plate map warnings\n\n",
      paste0("- ", unique(import_warnings), collapse = "\n"), "\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
```

Each plot is laid out like the plate. Panel titles give the well and its plate-map label; the grey number is the maximum force (μN) shown in that panel. Within a day's plot every well has the same x and y limits. The **All days** tab animates the protocol across days with x and y limits fixed across every day, so changes over time are directly comparable. PNGs are saved to ``r png_dir``, animations to ``r anim_dir``.

```{r plates}
#| results: asis
callout <- function(type, ...) cat("::: {.callout-", type, "}\n", ..., "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
x_label_for <- function(p) {
  s <- protocol_settings(cfg, p)
  if (identical(s$type, "snapshot")) paste0("Time from ", s$time_s, " s (s)") else "Time (s)"
}
show_image <- function(res, what) {
  if (inherits(res, "error")) callout("warning", "Could not draw ", what, ": ", conditionMessage(res))
  else cat("![](", img_link(res), "){width=100%}\n\n", sep = "")
}

# Read every file, then draw every image, both in worker processes (R/parallel.R).
# Each animation needs its protocol's days read first: limits are shared across days.
traces <- load_protocol_traces(files$file, files$protocol, cfg)
ok <- map_lgl(traces, \(tr) !inherits(tr, "error") && nrow(tr$data) > 0)
jobs <- list()
for (p in protocols) {
  okp <- which(files$protocol == p & ok)
  if (isTRUE(cfg$animation) && length(okp) >= 2) {
    jobs[[paste0("gif:", p)]] <- plate_gif_job(
      traces[okp], pm, plate_limits(traces[okp]), titles = paste0("Day ", files$day[okp]),
      subtitle = paste0(cfg$name, " · ", p), x_label = x_label_for(p),
      file = file.path(anim_dir, paste0(safe_filename(p), "_all-days.gif")))
  }
  for (i in okp) {
    jobs[[paste0("png:", i)]] <- plate_png_job(
      traces[[i]], pm, title = paste0(cfg$name, " · Day ", files$day[i], " · ", p),
      x_label = x_label_for(p),
      file = file.path(png_dir, p, paste0(safe_filename(paste0("d", files$day[i], "_", p)), ".png")))
  }
}
drawn <- setNames(run_plate_jobs(unname(jobs), cols, cfg), names(jobs))

for (p in protocols) {
  cat("\n\n## ", p, "\n\n", describe_protocol(p), "\n\n", sep = "")
  idx <- which(files$protocol == p)
  s <- protocol_settings(cfg, p)
  snap <- identical(s$type, "snapshot")

  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

  gif <- jobs[[paste0("gif:", p)]]
  if (!is.null(gif)) {
    cat("\n\n### All days ▶\n\n")
    res <- drawn[[paste0("gif:", p)]]
    if (!inherits(res, "error")) {
      cat("Days ", paste(files$day[idx[ok[idx]]], collapse = ", "), ", ", cfg$animation_delay_s,
          " s per day. Same x and y limits on every day (y: ",
          round(gif$limits$y[1]), "–", round(gif$limits$y[2]), " μN). Saved as `", gif$file, "`.\n\n",
          sep = "")
    }
    show_image(res, "the animation")
  }

  for (i in idx) {
    cat("\n\n### Day ", files$day[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
    tr <- traces[[i]]
    if (inherits(tr, "error")) {
      callout("warning", "Could not read `", basename(files$file[i]), "`: ", conditionMessage(tr))
      next
    }
    if (nrow(tr$data) == 0) {
      callout("warning", "`", basename(files$file[i]), "` has no data in the plotted window (",
              paste(tr$window, collapse = "–"), " s).")
      next
    }
    if (!snap && !is.null(s$end_s) && tr$file_end < s$end_s - 1) {
      callout("note", "Recording ends at ", round(tr$file_end, 1),
              " s, before the expected protocol end (", s$end_s, " s).")
    }
    cat("`", basename(files$file[i]), "`\n\n", sep = "")
    # Embed the saved PNG rather than print(): knitr's plot capture inside a
    # results: asis loop can attach each plot to the *next* tab.
    show_image(drawn[[paste0("png:", i)]], paste0("`", basename(files$file[i]), "`"))
  }
  cat("\n:::\n\n")
}
rm(traces, jobs)
par_stop()
```
